name: ef2026-onsite-guide
description: THE STANDARD Economic Forum 2026 onsite guide — one codebase, two sites (attendee / staff)

scripts.build:all: npm run build:attendee && npm run build:staff
scripts.build:fixtures: node scripts/build.mjs --audience attendee --out dist/attendee --fixtures && node scripts/build.mjs --audience staff --out dist/staff --fixtures
scripts.build:netlify: node scripts/build.mjs --out dist && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --dir dist
scripts.check: node scripts/check-dist.mjs --dir dist/attendee --audience attendee && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --dir dist/staff --audience staff && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --source .
